openQuestions: Where does the encryption key for the GitHub token come from? There is no crypto.subtle anywhere in the repo today and no user secret in the product. Phase 20ب's library lock (Rasd_Plan.md:1350) is the only candidate passphrase and is (a) optional, (b) scheduled after the MVP gate, (c) scoped to the library UI. If the key is itself stored in chrome.storage.local the claim «مشفَّر» that Phase 25 audits (Rasd_Plan.md:1688) is obfuscation. This is the decision that justifies Opus 5 on this phase and it should be settled before any code.

Does OAuth Device Flow actually fit inside «api.github.com فقط»? Device Flow's code and token endpoints are on github.com, not api.github.com, so a literal single-origin scope would leave only the personal-access-token path viable. I could not verify GitHub's endpoint hosts from this repo — this needs confirming against GitHub's docs before the permission set is frozen, because it changes both OPTIONAL_HOST_PERMISSIONS and the CSP allowlist.

Does `privacy.localOnly` (default TRUE) hard-block the GitHub path until the user flips it, or does connecting an integration implicitly flip it? The plan asserts both «مفتاح يمنع أي رفع» (1351) and a working GitHub integration (1427) without saying which wins. A user who never opens settings should still get a coherent answer.

The three Figma frame IDs Phase 21 is to be compared against — 73:361, 129:843, 72:488 (Rasd_Plan.md:1424) — appear nowhere else in the repo or Docs. Nothing maps them to `share / modal`, `share / link-created` and `24 — Integrations › connections`, so the visual acceptance step has no verifiable anchor today.

Should `src/modules/export/integrations/github.ts` still be the path if Phase 21 runs before Phase 19 creates `src/modules/export/`? Per ADR 0013 the order is 19 → 20أ → gate → 20ب → 21, so this is unlikely — but 21's local path depends on 19's standalone-HTML generator either way, which makes 21أ strictly unstartable until 19 lands. Worth confirming there is no intent to run 21 early.

Who owns fixing the already-shipped Offline.tsx copy («روابط المشاركة ستُصفّ حتى تعود الشبكة»)? It is a live false promise today, predating Phase 21, and would normally go into §6 as a discovered-contradiction row with an assigned phase, on the precedent of rows 56 and 80.

Adding an external origin to connect-src changes what the Chrome Web Store data-disclosure must say (Rasd_Plan.md:1805). Does the store text get written once in Phase 27, or does Phase 21 owe a draft of the GitHub disclosure at closure?
